title: Gwalior Rayon Silk Mfg. (Wvg.) Co. Ltd. v. Assistant Commissioner of Sales Tax

content.caseIdentity: Gwalior Rayon Silk Mfg. (Wvg.) Co. Ltd. v. Assistant Commissioner of Sales Tax, (1974) 4 SCC 98
content.facts: The Court considered the extent to which legislative functions could be delegated.
questionsBeforeCourt: What distinguishes permissible delegation from abdication of legislative responsibility?
content.ratioDecidendi: The legislature must retain essential legislative functions while permitting subordinate legislation to fill in details within the policy laid down.
content.holding: The Court applied the distinction between essential legislative function and implementation detail.
